title: Rust Pattern Matching
learning_objectives: Define enums with simple and data-bearing variants.
Use exhaustive match expressions to handle every enum variant.
Destructure carried values and use catch-all or guarded patterns when appropriate.
explanation: Patterns let Rust inspect and unpack values. A match expression must account for every possible enum variant, so adding a new variant reveals places that need new handling instead of leaving cases unhandled.

examples.title: Define data-bearing variants
Destructure every variant
Use a match guard

completion_criteria: Exercise tests cover every enum variant, including variants with carried data
Learner can explain why a match must handle every enum variant
Learner can identify values destructured by the match arms
